title: Define the expression node shapes
description: You can read the fields that later visitors will inspect.

steps.description: Num stores a value. BinOp stores an operator and its two child expressions.
Var stores a name. Let stores a binding and body, while IfExpr stores a condition and two branches.

steps.question: Does Call store a list of arguments or one argument?
steps.answer: It stores one argument in arg, alongside func.

steps.description: FuncDef records one parameter and a body. The final message confirms these class definitions loaded; this snippet constructs no example tree.
